ModMetaData.name: Dev Mode Hotkey
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Hotkey to switch development mode on and off. Default is KeyPad_Period (the key between 0 and Enter on the keypad).
Change the binding in Options -> Controls -> Keyboard Configuration: Modify -> Developer tools -> Toggle Development Mode.
This is a replacement for NightmareCorporation's Development Mode Hotkey. Disable the workshop version before enabling this one. It avoids a RimWorld 1.6 NullReferenceException during loading by not polling the hotkey until the UI actually exists.
